commit_message: Preserve ADR 0110 authored profiles on reimport
pr_title: Implement ADR 0110 humanoid profiles and motion
pr_body:
Continues ADR 0110 implementation. This repair makes HumanoidMotion visible to the Asset Inspector, threads persisted model-owned Humanoid profiles through reimport, reuses structurally valid authored mappings, preserves stale authored mappings instead of silently replacing them, and excludes stale mappings from portable-motion bake until repaired.
